auto-anonymize.label: Auto-anonymize inactive customers
auto-anonymize.helper_text: When enabled, customers with no activity for the configured number of days are automatically and irreversibly anonymized.

auto-anonymize-days.label: Days of inactivity
auto-anonymize-days.helper_text: Minimum 90 days. Customers inactive this long will be anonymized.
auto-anonymize-days.v8n_required: Enter the number of inactive days (at least 90).

delete.delete_prompt: Are you sure you'd like to reset these settings?
